notes:
v4.6.89 — Lifetime P/L default + min-positions on every bot + tidier overview

✨ CHANGES
• Overview & account summary now default to the bot's LIFETIME return (new 'ALL' period) instead of 1D — so each card shows how that specific bot has done since it started. You can still switch to 1D/1W/1M/etc.
• 'Min positions to hold' now appears on EVERY bot tab (was LONG-only), saved per bot — set a floor so a cautious bot still deploys into its top names.
• Overview bot cards now stretch to fill the row evenly instead of crowding the left; a lone card on the last row spans the full width.

Update via the in-app banner.
